verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product with GitHub PR reviews, a local review CLI, chat, one-click fixes and an MCP server. As an AI developer tool with IDE-facing surfaces, it could plausibly ship completions, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents inline as-you-type completions or next-edit suggestions. Fix generation and local CLI reviews are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
